links.comparator_used: Primary prompt (general practitioner role) without WAO criteria
links.outcome: Anaphylaxis detection performance (precision, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy)
links.effect: Adding WAO criteria slightly improved performance of older models (GPT 3.5 + 4 configuration); for GPT 4 Turbo the additional information did not enhance precision (primary prompt GPT 4 Turbo: 90.6% precision, 100% sensitivity, 99.5% specificity, 99.5% accuracy, kappa 0.95).
links.quote: The inclusion of WAO criteria slightly improved the performance of older models (GPT 3.5 + 4 configuration).
